question: You asked "do we even need those tags?" No: tags are gone from all three. Round-003 C stays: full width, no heading, bar at the bottom. Which reason input feels right without them? Pick and type a reason in each.

variants.label: One row, one-line reason
variants.changes: "Do we even need those tags?" No tags. One row: pick, a single-line reason that fills the rest of the row, submit. Enter submits. The smallest bar.

variants.label: Roomy 2-line reason
variants.changes: "Do we even need those tags?" No tags. Pick on the left, a 2-line reason taking the rest, a large submit on the right. The bar is about two rows tall and asks for a sentence.

variants.label: Pick first, then reason
variants.changes: "Do we even need those tags?" No tags. The bar shows only the pick buttons. A pick slides in the reason and submit on the same row and puts the cursor in the reason.
